positions.title: Senior Support Services Consultant
positions.description:
•	Working closely with pre-sales consultants to find technical solutions.
•	Developing custom requirements for client sites; JavaScript, JQuery and HTML/CSS, Velocity.
•	Developing solutions via the TrafficLIVE REST API.
•	Integration with third party vendors; Xero and MYOB.
•	Technical support via phone and online for Australasia.
•	Mapping and migrating previous systems to centralised web based portals.

positions.title: Customer Care Analyst
positions.description:
Traffic LIVE is the market-leading online studio, project & workflow management and resource planning system that helps creative agencies effortlessly manage people and project processes to deliver a profitable end product that surpasses client expectations. 

•	Providing technical support and troubleshooting for Australasia and the US.
•	Configuration of custom template reporting using HTML/CSS, JavaScript, JQuery and Velocity.
•	Configuration and troubleshooting of Xero and MYOB accounts integration.

positions.title: Australian Support Manager
positions.description:
Australian Support and Installations Manager for a leading 
software development company, including FileMaker based Traffic and
Flex / SaaS based TrafficLIVE.

- HTML, CSS and JQuery development.
- Integration development with account packages (MYOB & Xero).
- Telephone and email support to over 500 clients in Australasia and worldwide
- Setup and configuration of OS X 10.*, Windows Server 2003/2008 and IIS/Apache.
- Configuration of IIS and firewalls Including Server Roles.
- Setting up and configuration of FileMaker Server with Web Services. 
- Remote Desktop assistance either through VPN/Teamviewer/Citrix or Logmein.
- Remote backup and administration of servers.
- Windows & OS X desktop installation / troubleshooting.
- Local office IT and systems administrator.
